name: set_red
description: Sets the red channel of a color

name: set_blue
description: Sets the blue channel of a color

name: set_green
description: Sets the green channel of a color

name: set_alpha
description: Sets the alpha channel of a color

name: set_hue
description: Sets the hue channel of a color

name: set_saturation
description: Sets the saturation of a color

name: set_lightness
description: Sets the lightness of a color

name: lighten
description: Lightens a color
arguments: Float - amount to adjust lightness by

name: to_color
description: Parses a CSS color string into a color

name: invert
description: Inverts a color

name: grayscale
description: Converts a color to grayscale

name: auto_lightness
description:
Automatically lightens or darkens a color based on its current lightness
 If the color is dark, it will be lightened. If it is light, it will be darkened.
arguments: Float - amount to adjust lightness by

name: saturate
description: Adjusts the saturation of a color

name: blend
description: Blends two colors together using hue blending

name: harmonize
description:
Harmonizes a color with another using harmonization
 This shifts the hue of the original color toward the target color.

name: format
description: Formats a color into a certain format just like what using the .format on a color keyword would. This is useful for colors that are defined in the templates as there is no way to format them otherwise.
arguments: String - what to format the color into

name: snake_case
description: Converts a value to snake_case

name: lower_case
description: Converts a value to lowercase

name: camel_case
description: Converts a value to camelCase

name: pascal_case
description: Converts a value to PascalCase

name: kebab_case
description: Converts a value to kebab-case

name: replace
description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring
